bugs.title: Truck 103 label still overlaps the 'San Francisco' city label at 1440
bugs.evidence: Screenshot first-glance-header-kpis-map-w1440.png: the '103' pill at about (552,432) covers the 'San Francisco' text (it reads 'S...isco'). The 101 marker also sits on the 'L' of 'Los Angeles'. The check only compares truck labels with each other, and those do not overlap, so it passed. The criterion also forbids truck-vs-city overlap. The app is frontend-only (localStorage), so there is no API to cross-check. This is a visual bug.

action_items: Fix the Truck 103 label offset (and the 101 marker) so they avoid city labels. Consider adding city-label testids so the check can assert truck-vs-city overlap.
